rationale: Accept the T2/T3 claims, classified as T3. evidence: Fulcher & Scott, Sociology (OUP), ch.1 on levels of society; upstream OUP MCQ ch01.

rationale: I accept that this is legally doubtful. The student's character for dishonesty is not an element of malicious prosecution. evidence: FRE 404(a)(1), 405(b); Restatement (Second) Torts §653 elements of malicious prosecution.

rationale: Partly accept the T3 claim. Under Lovasco, good-faith investigative delay does not violate due process even when it causes prejudice, so E is correct. evidence: United States v. Lovasco, 431 U.S. 783 (1977); United States v. Marion, 404 U.S. 307 (1971).
